using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Net;
using System.Net.Sockets;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Roost.Client;

class Program {
 static async Task<int> Main(){
  bool all=true;
  foreach(var setup in new[]{(Heartbeat:false, Capacity:1),(Heartbeat:true, Capacity:2),(Heartbeat:true, Capacity:1)}){
   bool heartbeat=setup.Heartbeat;
   var listener=new TcpListener(IPAddress.Loopback,0);listener.Start();
   int port=((IPEndPoint)listener.LocalEndpoint).Port;
   int business=0;
   var server=Task.Run(async()=>{
    using var peer=await listener.AcceptTcpClientAsync();
    var stream=peer.GetStream();
    var auth=await PacketCodec.ReadAsync(stream, PacketCodec.DefaultMaxPayload);
    var ack=PacketCodec.Encode(new Packet(0,auth.Sequence,Array.Empty<byte>()));
    await stream.WriteAsync(ack);
    var request=await PacketCodec.ReadAsync(stream, PacketCodec.DefaultMaxPayload);business++;
    await Task.Delay(400);
    try{await stream.WriteAsync(PacketCodec.Encode(new Packet(43,request.Sequence,Array.Empty<byte>())));}catch(IOException){}
    await Task.Delay(100);
   });
   using var connection=new Connection(new ConnectionOptions{Host="127.0.0.1",Port=port,MaxPendingRequests=setup.Capacity,HeartbeatInterval=heartbeat?TimeSpan.FromMilliseconds(100):TimeSpan.Zero,HeartbeatTimeout=TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1),RequestTimeout=TimeSpan.FromSeconds(2)});
   await connection.ConnectAsync("ticket");
   try{await connection.RequestAsync(42,43,ReadOnlyMemory<byte>.Empty);Console.WriteLine($"heartbeat={heartbeat}, capacity={setup.Capacity}: request completed");}
   catch(Exception e){all=false;Console.WriteLine($"heartbeat={heartbeat}, capacity={setup.Capacity}: healthy request failed: {e.GetType().Name}; state={connection.State}; close={connection.LastError}");}
   await server;listener.Stop();
   if(business!=1)throw new Exception("fixture: request did not reach server");
  }
  return all?0:1;
 }
}
